exceptions.reason: The window is transparent so the rounded .shell gives it its shape; .shell paints the theme background.
Segmented control: the options share one track and read as a single control.
List rows: full-width rows that highlight on hover, stacked like menu items.
Options show their title as text; a row half scrolled out of its list reads as unlabeled to the check.
Window caption buttons sit edge to edge, as in the OS title bar.
Math follows TeX metrics and fonts.
